problem: The eager XLS/XLSB implementations of shared Worksheet and Cell traits used zero-based native indices despite the documented one-based contract. Direct generic reads and FormulaEvaluator therefore selected the wrong cells; the facade compensated locally, masking the leaf defect. XLSB column-label accumulation could also overflow before an invalid address reached the grid guard.
changes: Translate and validate shared numeric cell/cell_value arguments at each leaf boundary. Report shared Cell positions and inclusive worksheet dimensions as one-based. Validate A1 labels against each format grid before converting them, and use checked arithmetic in the XLSB column-label parser.

Retain explicit zero-based native get_cell/cell_at, constructors, concrete Cell row/column, wire/editor APIs, positional source reads and XLSB Grid dimensions. Correct shared-trait consumers and remove the compensating second conversions from facade adapters.

Add four owning-format native regressions for numeric/coordinate/iterator agreement, stored and absent cells, row indexing, dimensions, format-grid bounds and overflowing labels. Add two facade regressions exercising direct FormulaEvaluator owners and public Auto/Eager worksheet grids.

Adjust writer checks, native preservation comparisons and the profiling oracle to translate explicitly between shared and native indices, retaining their original cell/value expectations. The profiling example also accepts explicit --sheet 0, matching its default and native tab index.

Recognize registered Tokio async tests in coverage validation and enable eval in the facade-format-tests release/CI lane. Add a guard against crediting plain async helpers and update gate selection expectations.

resolved_findings.resolution: Numeric Print_015 B2, A1-coordinate lookup and direct evaluator reads now agree: XLS Float(42), XLSB Int(42). Native form-control B2 is Bool(true), and full direct/facade grids agree. This is a supported-behavior fix, not an unsupported boundary disposition.

api_behavior.shared_traits: Worksheet::cell and cell_value accept one-based positions; Cell trait accessors and inclusive dimensions use the same convention. row()/rows() retain zero-based row indexing. Invalid numeric or A1 coordinates return the leaf InvalidCellReference variant; valid absent cells remain Empty.
api_behavior.native_storage: Concrete XLS/XLSB Cell::row/column and native get_cell/cell_at remain zero-based. Generic Cell::row/column report one-based positions. Native source readers and editors retain their explicit zero-based contracts.
api_behavior.migration: Callers that supplied zero-based coordinates to the shared traits must add one or use native stored-cell accessors. Cow/trait cell positions are now one-based. The public facade preserves its existing one-based behavior.
api_behavior.inertness: Tests read saved scalars, errors and form-state data through the evaluator; they do not execute controls, macros, external providers or perform fresh Excel validation.

verification_scope.native_reads: Both owning formats exercise every stored cell in the native form-controls workbook. Numeric lookup, coordinate lookup and iterators agree with exact positions and values. C8 is an addressed Empty cell; row(1)[1] remains the native B2 checkbox; dimensions are (1,1,12,4). Native storage access still reports zero-based (1,1).
verification_scope.bounds: Zero axes, values beyond each grid, u32::MAX, invalid/overlong labels and oversized row labels refuse without panic. The final valid IV65536/XFD1048576 cell is addressed correctly and Empty, without expanding the sparse grid.
verification_scope.evaluator: Direct XLS/XLSB generic evaluators and Auto/Eager facades return matching 12x4 form-state grids including saved #N/A; XLSX facade modes agree too. Native metadata Print_015 B2 values qualify the exact receipt-060 finding. All input bytes remain unchanged.
verification_scope.adapters: Full owner, operations and facade tests cover stored/absent cell wrapping, source cursor positions, binary indexing, dimensions, native preservation, source publication and refresh regression behavior after removing double conversions.
verification_scope.limits: No complete Excel calculation engine, fresh Office reopen or execution of active content is claimed. Historical authoring statuses and unresolved native-fixture/UI/external handoffs are unchanged.
